mainText: Hello, Verona! At 8 PM, here is today's balanced dish. We have clear skies over Reddan Soccer Park with a waxing crescent moon. If you are an early bird, the International Space Station will be visible for two minutes starting at 5:35 AM tomorrow, rising over Mount Horeb and heading toward Fitchburg and Madison while passing almost directly overhead. The overnight low will be 62 degrees, and there is no rain in the forecast.

The City of Verona has announced updated sewer and stormwater rates to ensure our utilities remain self-supporting and properly maintained, while the city also recently celebrated the four local students who won the I Voted sticker contest for the upcoming November election.

Today, Epic Systems is hosting its User Group Meeting, and tomorrow is packed with fun including trivia at Hop Haus and Lake Lou-ee, followed by Wednesday's Farmer's Market and trivia at The Bogey Factory.
In a noteworthy call for service on Friday, August 15, an officer arrested a 44-year-old woman for a first offence O W I after finding her passed out behind the wheel of a swerving vehicle.
Today is the perfect time to grab a scoop of the Caramel Peanut Buttercup flavor of the day. They are open until 10 PM tonight, giving you plenty of time to stop by for a treat.
